title: Provider Governance Durable Batch Execution
problem: Metadata Candidate Review batch apply is currently bounded and synchronous; durable progress, cancellation, retry-ready status, and larger operator selections need an ADR 0053 job-backed control-plane boundary.
gates: JSONL validation for docs/workstreams/provider-governance-durable-batch-execution/TASKS.jsonl, CAMPAIGNS.jsonl, and CONTEXT.jsonl
browser or local HTTP route smoke if route behavior changes

evidence.summary: Opened the durable Candidate Review batch execution lane after PGBR closeout and selected core/DB durable batch state as the first executable task.

Added Candidate Review durable batch domain records, explicit job kind/resource class, repository methods, SQLite/PostgreSQL schema support, backend implementations, and an idempotency/atomicity contract test.

Added redaction-safe Admin create/status routes for queued Candidate Review durable batches, generated Admin contract coverage, idempotent replay behavior, and persisted job creation without Provider Mapping writes.

Executed queued Candidate Review durable batches through DurableJobRuntime, mapped the job resource class to the metadata shared budget, persisted per-item outcomes, and synchronized cancellation/failed terminal batch state.

Connected Web Admin Candidate Review batch selection to durable batch create/status APIs, rendered queued/running/completed/failed/cancelled status safely, added route/data-source coverage for raw-key and provider-payload redaction, and kept the Web bundle under budget.

Closed the durable batch execution lane after fresh Web, docs, JSON/JSONL, local route smoke, and diff-check evidence, and kept Public Client API, related hierarchy application, provider endpoint breadth, scheduler priority, and audit/undo as focused follow-ons.
